## Summary

[Partial] Remove the torn CV boot to access internal components for cleaning and relubing axle shaft bearings. [t2064]

## Tips & gotchas

- Stock axles are sufficient for Independent Front Suspension (IFS) setups without heavy modifications. [t2064]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Ignoring torn boots which leads to lack of clean lube and eventual breakage. [t2064]
- [Partial] Expecting a complete factory Heavy Duty replacement, as options may be limited or custom-fitted. [t2064]
